Name: Sophia the Blue Moon Avenger (Stardew Druid)
Author: neosinf
Description:
===========================================
Stardew Druid: Sophia, Blue Moon Avenger
===========================================

Sophia is ready to adventure with the farmer, and for that purpose, has decided to reveal her own femme fatale secret identity!

This mod doesn't do anything on it's own. Instead it tells Stardew Druid, the main mod, to enable recruitment of the Sophia character in Stardew Valley Expanded when using the Recruit Hero effect.

[color=#f6b26b]NOTE: Because the assets for this mod are packaged in Stardew Druid, this extension does not need to be downloaded and installed to be enabled for players who have 'heroic crossovers' set to true in their Stardew Druid configuration file.[/color]

This mod can be enabled and disabled without affecting save files or progression in Stardew Druid.

Check out heroes from other crossovers here!

﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32743]Lance of the First Slash[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32565]Sevinae of Alchemistry[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32396]Astarion of Baldur's Village[/url]

------------------------------------
Future development
------------------------------------

Not sure, I might be able to do more with this mod based on feedback from players and the SVE team.

------------------------------------
Sophia looks different
------------------------------------

That's because this is my artistic vision for Sophia based on the idea of how she would dress as a ninja inspired vigilante, and it's also in order to align Sophia's sprite animations with the Stardew Druid character model.

------------------------------------
How do I recruit Sophia?
------------------------------------

If you're familiar with Stardew Druid, and you've unlocked the Gift of the Heiress in your playthrough, then you'll know what to do, just cast Rite of Mists: Smite on Sophia when you see her onscreen. Once you see the 'Sophia has been added to the ledger of recruits' notice, go to the Stardew Druid journal, press the lightning sword icon to open the ledger menu, click on Sophia's entry, then click the check box to summon her.

If you are not interested in a Druid playthrough, you can use the set progress feature in the Stardew Druid configuration to skip right to the Gift of the Heiress unlock, which is progress 30.

Alternatively, the recruit system is immediately available for Magic only mode users of Stardew Druid (either by setting in config or by using the Magic By Neosinf mod).
